title: Burning at Wonderwerk Cave
summary: Analysis of intact sediments at Wonderwerk Cave, Northern Cape, South Africa, found burned bone and ashed plant remains in an early Acheulean layer dated to about 1.0 million years ago. The authors called it the earliest secure evidence for burning in an archaeological context; a news summary says it pushed back human use of fire by 300,000 years.

uncertainty.note: Sources give only approximately 1.0 Ma; the margin is a placeholder for that rounding.
